g.text: U11 ~0.27W budget: solder EP to GND copper, thermal vias at layout. U13 +5R stays separate (~1.4W).

g.desc: U11 ~0.27W budget: solder EP to GND copper, thermal vias at layout. U13 +5R stays separate (~1.4W).

g.text: C46+C57 and C48+C58: each pair directly at IN pins. C47/C49 directly at OUT pins.

g.desc: C46+C57 and C48+C58: each pair directly at IN pins. C47/C49 directly at OUT pins.

g.text: NR/SS100n; CFF10n each. Keep CS VD+ tied to VA+. Existing rail-fault/output mute retained.

g.desc: NR/SS100n; CFF10n each. Keep CS VD+ tied to VA+. Existing rail-fault/output mute retained.

g.text: Negative lower arm returns to BUF (pin8), NOT GND. EN tied to +15V; EP11 tied to GND.

g.desc: Negative lower arm returns to BUF (pin8), NOT GND. EN tied to +15V; EP11 tied to GND.

g.text: SELV ONLY: externally regulated +/-15V input, NEVER P68 high-voltage power rails.

g.desc: SELV ONLY: externally regulated +/-15V input, NEVER P68 high-voltage power rails.

g.text: Nominal +/-15V; maximum +/-15.75V. Supply rating >=250mA positive / >=100mA negative.
